Hildegard 0.1.8 is a pre-alpha. It makes websites the way a designer does: start from your Figma, a pen.dev file, your
current site or a finished template, watch it live at every width, and change it by hand or with any AI app.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update`.

## New

- **Sites.** A new page in the Studio, `hildegard sites`, and eight `site_*` tools for AI apps. A site is plain HTML
  and CSS that you own, kept by Hildegard so the Studio, the CLI and every linked app work on the same files.
- **Imports.** Bring a design in from **Figma** (a file or frame link: frames become pages, auto layout becomes flex,
  styles become light and dark tokens, and a render of each frame is kept), a **pen.dev** `.pen` file, a **live web
  page** (its words, styles and pictures, without its scripts, plus a screenshot), or a ZIP. Link Figma once with
  `hildegard figma token` or in the Studio; the token stays in your keychain and goes only to Figma.
- **Templates.** Eight finished sites to start from: Hearth (bakery or café), Atelier (architecture or design
  studio), Ledger (software with pricing), Practice (clinic), Gathering (conference), Parish (parish or
  congregation), Manual (documentation) and Journal (long-form essay). Each passes every web check in light and dark
  at every width, and CI keeps it that way. Each names its pictures with a prompt and an aspect, for your GPU to
  render. Apache-2.0.
- **The canvas.** A site's pages live at phone, tablet and desktop width side by side. Click anything to see what it
  is and how it's styled, change its words in place, and change a design token to see it in every frame at once.
  The frames reload as an AI app writes.
- **Held to the design.** A web loop started with `site_id` checks the site as it stands, and an imported site is
  measured against its Figma frame or screenshot, so "it matches the design" is checked, not claimed.
- **Linking** reaches OMP, Pi and Gemini CLI, with skills and terms-safe sign-in.
- **The install page** shows the whole studio, with moving takes and a new link preview.

## Known limits

- Importing a live page, and the web checks, need Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave on the computer Hildegard runs on.
- The canvas retunes words and tokens; moving things around is for an AI app, so every change is checked.
- Macs don't render on their own GPU yet. Pair a Mac with a computer that has an NVIDIA or AMD GPU
  (`hildegard choir join`).
- The Windows and macOS apps aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper ask you to confirm
  the first launch.
- claude.ai, ChatGPT, Grok and Grok Bot reach Hildegard only at a public link (`hildegard host --funnel`). Hildegard
  Link, the encrypted relay that needs no Tailscale, is coming soon.
- LTX models follow Lightricks' license: free under $10M yearly revenue, and not for products that compete with
  Lightricks. Wan 2.2 is Apache-2.0.
